experiment: Strict DB3V few-shot fine-tuning ablation with multiple seeds

policies.head_only: Only the final softmax Dense layer is trainable.
policies.bn_head: All BatchNormalization layers and the final softmax Dense layer are trainable.
policies.bn_head_replay: BN+Head with a class-balanced Xeno-canto training replay buffer at a 1:1 replay-to-DB3V-slice ratio.
policies.full: Every layer is trainable, including all BatchNormalization layers.

random_seed_scope: Fixed external support/held-out recordings; seed changes the internal support train/validation split, replay sampling, batch order, and TensorFlow stochastic operations.
selection: Policy/epoch selection uses support validation recording macro-F1 multiplied by capped Xeno-canto validation macro-F1 retention.
db3v_final_test: Every run is evaluated after training on the feature-matched common 20-shot held-out set. Held-out metrics are reported but never used by the training script or selected_by_mean_adaptation_score.
xeno_forgetting_test: Final Xeno-canto validation macro-F1, absolute change from the base model, and retention ratio are recorded for every run.
